name: Sparking Oozeshardling Node
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails

stealth.note: (trained) (or –10 and no minimum proficiency if the oozeshardling node's electric pulse reaction has been triggered)

description: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.
disable: Two successful DC 23 Arcana or DC 23 Occultism (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or DC 25 Acrobatics or DC 25 Thievery (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 Acid Damage damage (2d6 Acid Damage on a critical failure).
reset: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.
routine: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll 1d4 #direction to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Electric Pulse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters a space within 10 feet of the sparking oozeshardling or the sparking oozeshardling is created by the divine oozeshard's Spawn Oozeshardling Node ability

Effect The sparking oozeshardling unleashes a shocking blast that deals 5d6 Electricity Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:emanation around it (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save).
